bookingOpens: Online or by phone; no email bookings. Online booking is for tables of up to six.
cancellation: Card details are needed to book. Cancel by email more than 24 hours ahead at no charge; later cancellations and no-shows may be charged £50 a head if the table can't be resold.
groups: Tables of up to six in the main restaurant. The private dining room takes 10 to 14 guests, with three courses at £85 at lunch and £125 at dinner and a minimum spend.
duration: Tables are returned after 2 hours 15 minutes unless agreed in advance.
byob: Corkage £50 a bottle at dinner and £25 at lunch, one 75cl bottle per person up to four a table; free on Sunday evenings.
